startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Listing/category pages on furniture.com to start scraping from. Defaults to the homepage.

maxPagesPerCrawl.title: Max pages per crawl
maxPagesPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages (including start URLs and pagination) to process.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to fetch in parallel.

followPagination.title: Follow pagination / category links
followPagination.description: If true, the crawler enqueues 'next page' and sub-category listing links it finds on each page.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings provided by Apify. Uses Apify residential proxy by default.
